applicability.note: Optional inclusion: an operator may publish a separate CCTV policy instead; if included here, all elements are required.

rules.statement: A fixed-video-device operation and management policy may be included in the privacy policy instead of a separate policy.

If included, cover all of: (1) installation basis and purpose; (2) number, locations, filming range; (3) manager, department, persons with access; (4) filming hours, retention period, storage place, processing method; (5) how and where the operator checks footage; (6) handling of access and other requests; (7) technical, managerial and physical protection; (8) other necessary matters.
If installation or management is outsourced, name the vendor and contact.

goodPatterns: Eight numbered blocks following the checklist; tables for count/location and time/retention/place; note that access or deletion requests are limited to footage of the requester.

commonDefects.defect: CCTV block missing retention period or persons with access.

warnNote: Handling = warn: drafter produces a manual-review placeholder with the checklist; installation-basis legality (e.g. parking lots) needs legal review.

needsVerification.note: Parking-lot basis (주차장법 시행규칙 6(1), >30 spaces) appears only as an example note (L2717); do not cite without verification.
